scope: Original TJS lexical namespace for the for statement, expressed by an existing Block HIR scope. No game-specific metadata repair.

evidence.EnterForCode: Lines2907-2918 call EnterBlock before the initializing clause, explicitly even when no variables are introduced.
evidence.ExitForCode: Lines2956-2991 emit step/backedge, patch exits and call ExitBlock.

implementation: HIR enters an existing ScopeKind::Block before initializer/condition/step/body analysis and leaves it after the loop. Binding IDs preserve outer lookup after nested loops, continue/break and return; no new host/GPU dependency. This patch corrects lexical binding resolution; it does not claim newly implemented deterministic object-finalizer timing for all block forms.
actual_trigger: Original StandInformation metadata initialization nests two for(var i...) loops and then assigns info[i]; the leaking inner binding caused baseInfo to be void, later failing StandImage.updateImage filename access. Owner script data remain unchanged.
verification: Four self-authored release VM tests cover nested metadata selection and continue/break, declaration-free outer index updates and unbraced-body declaration shadowing, break/return lookup, and TopLevel global-vs-loop-local binding. Full 426-test library suite passed; actual owner-game progression is logged separately.
decompiler_regression: Correct loop locals now occupy negative registers at TopLevel. The decompiler must declare them once in the object prologue and then assign; emitting var again in a while body shadows the live counter. Native named global declaration and positive temporary policies remain unchanged. Full 426-test library suite, including control-flow round-trip and fuzz cases, passed after this fix.
